about: Reviewed occurrences of words that NAME a server credential (rule server-credential-mention) in the built site, e.g. a library's own check for the text 'sb_secret_'. Real key-shaped values (rules private-key, supabase-secret-key, resend-api-key, stripe-live-key, service-role-key-value, supabase-jwt-not-anon) can never be allowlisted. Add an entry only after reading the reported context and source file: { "fingerprint": "<16 hex from the report>", "rule": "server-credential-mention", "source": "<file:line from the report>", "reason": "<why it is not a credential, at least 20 characters>", "reviewedBy": "<name>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. The fingerprint changes if the surrounding code changes, so each library update is reviewed again.
